name: Scott Chambers
bio: Scott begun as an actor performing in films such as "Chicken", "Malevolent" for Netflix and "Doctor Jekyll" opposite Eddie Izzard. Under a second name - Scott Jeffrey - he has produced 114 Feature Films in the space of eight years with every single one being distributed worldwide. More recently "Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey" has gone viral with a cinema release in over 1500 screens in the US.
